description: This file defines the Comment class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, representing a cell comment with properties like author, text content, size, position, visibility, and background image.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents a cell comment with properties such as author, text, size, visibility, fill color, alignment, and background image. Provides methods to manipulate comment appearance and content.

methods.name: getAuthor
methods.description: Returns the author of the comment.

methods.name: setAuthor
methods.description: Sets the author of the comment.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the rich text content of the comment.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the rich text content of the comment.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Gets the width of the comment box.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the comment box.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Gets the height of the comment box.

methods.name: setHeight
methods.description: Sets the height of the comment box.

methods.name: getMarginLeft
methods.description: Gets the left margin of the comment.

methods.name: setMarginLeft
methods.description: Sets the left margin of the comment.

methods.name: getMarginTop
methods.description: Gets the top margin of the comment.

methods.name: setMarginTop
methods.description: Sets the top margin of the comment.

methods.name: getVisible
methods.description: Checks if the comment is visible by default.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the default visibility of the comment.

methods.name: setFillColor
methods.description: Sets the fill color of the comment background.

methods.name: getFillColor
methods.description: Returns the fill color object.

methods.name: setAlignment
methods.description: Sets the alignment of the comment.

methods.name: getAlignment
methods.description: Returns the alignment setting.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the current state of the comment.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the Comment object.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the plain text of the comment.

methods.name: hasBackgroundImage
methods.description: Checks if a background image is set and valid.

methods.name: getBackgroundImage
methods.description: Returns the background image Drawing object.

methods.name: setBackgroundImage
methods.description: Sets the background image for the comment.

methods.name: setSizeAsBackgroundImage
methods.description: Adjusts the comment size to match the background image dimensions.
